message: Sample data for the CyberShield practice project (fictional companies).

data.title: ShopKita Online Store
data.description: A database backup of an online shop was left open on the internet. Customer logins and contact details were copied.

data.title: BayarCepat E-Wallet
data.description: Attackers used passwords leaked from other sites to log in to wallet accounts. Users who reused passwords lost money.

data.title: KampusNet Student Portal
data.description: A phishing email tricked a staff member into typing their password on a fake login page. The attacker then exported student records.

data.title: FotoBagi Photo Sharing
data.description: A weak admin password protected the control panel. After it was guessed, user profiles and password hashes were downloaded.

data.title: SehatKu Clinic Booking
data.description: A fake mobile app sent by chat message asked staff to install an .apk file, which gave attackers access to the booking system.

data.title: GameZone Forum
data.description: An old forum software with a known security hole was never updated. Attackers copied the whole member table.
